hero.title: See the World with Perfect Vision
hero.description: Premium eyewear, professional eye care, and personalized optical solutions designed for your lifestyle.

about.title: A practice built on precision, care and trust
about.description: Optic is dedicated to providing high-quality eyewear, professional vision care and expert fitting services.
about.description2: Every visit begins with a thorough examination and ends with eyewear made precisely for your eyes, your face and the way you live.

vision.title: A clearer vision for better everyday life
vision.description: Our vision is to become a trusted destination for modern vision care and eyewear, combining clinical excellence with thoughtful customer experience.
vision.description2: We continuously seek better solutions, better technology and better ways to help every customer see and feel their best.

mission.title: Making professional vision care personal
mission.description: Our mission is to deliver reliable vision care, quality eyewear and expert service tailored to every individual.
mission.description2: We focus on accuracy, comfort and long-term relationships with our customers, ensuring every detail of their experience receives the attention it deserves.

services.title: Everything your eyewear needs
services.intro: From choosing the right frame to lens installation, adjustments and repairs, we take care of the details that keep your glasses looking and feeling their best.

prescriptionGlasses.title: Prescription Glasses
prescriptionGlasses.text: A wide selection of frames and prescription eyewear for different styles and needs.

sunglasses.title: Sunglasses
sunglasses.text: Stylish sunglasses with quality lenses and UV protection.

lensInstallation.title: Lens Installation
lensInstallation.text: Professional installation and replacement of lenses in your frames.

frameAdjustment.title: Frame Adjustment
frameAdjustment.text: Careful adjustments to improve the fit, comfort and alignment of your glasses.

glassesRepair.title: Glasses Repair
glassesRepair.text: Repair services for hinges, nose pads, frames and other eyewear components.

lensReplacement.title: Lens Replacement
lensReplacement.text: Replace scratched or damaged lenses while keeping your existing frame.

eyewearAssistance.title: Eyewear Assistance
eyewearAssistance.text: Helpful guidance when choosing frames, lenses and the right fit for your needs.

cleaningCare.title: Cleaning & Care
cleaningCare.text: Professional cleaning and care to help keep your eyewear looking its best.
